ready2_open_rewrite.resolved_question_text: A variable speed drive rated for \(1500\,\text{rpm}, 40\,\text{Nm}\) is reversing under no load. The figure shows the reversing torque and the speed during the transient. Calculate the moment of inertia of the drive.
ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The left torque diagram shows that during the reversal transient there is a rectangular positive torque pulse, with amplitude labeled as +20 Nm and duration labeled as 0.5 sec. The right speed diagram shows the speed linearly rising from the initial -1500 rpm to the final +500 rpm. Reasoning: When there is no load, the applied electromagnetic torque is equal to the inertial torque, namely T = Jα. The speed change amount is Δn = 500 - (-1500) = 2000 rpm. Converted into angular speed change: Δω = 2000 × 2π/60 = 209.44 rad/s. This change occurs within 0.5 s, so the angular acceleration α = 209.44/0.5 = 418.88 rad/s². From J = T/α = 20/418.88 = 0.0477 kg·m², it is approximately 0.048 kg·m².

raw_record.question_text: A variable speed drive rated for \(1500\,\text{rpm}, 40\,\text{Nm}\) is reversing under no load. The figure shows the reversing torque and the speed during the transient. Calculate the moment of inertia of the drive.

method.method_draft: First describe the image: identify the torque pulse height and duration from the torque plot, and identify the initial and final speeds from the speed plot. Then compute the angular acceleration from the speed change over 0.5 s after converting rpm to rad/s. Since the drive is under no load, set the applied torque equal to inertial torque and solve J = T/alpha.
method.CoT_raw: 图像描述：左侧扭矩图显示在反转瞬态期间有一个矩形正向扭矩脉冲，幅值标为 +20 Nm，持续时间标为 0.5 sec。右侧速度图显示速度从初始的 -1500 rpm 线性上升到最终的 +500 rpm。推理：无负载时，外加电磁转矩等于惯性转矩，即 T = Jα。速度变化量为 Δn = 500 - (-1500) = 2000 rpm。换算为角速度变化：Δω = 2000 × 2π/60 = 209.44 rad/s。该变化发生在 0.5 s 内，所以角加速度 α = 209.44/0.5 = 418.88 rad/s²。由 J = T/α = 20/418.88 = 0.0477 kg·m²，约为 0.048 kg·m²。

planner_metadata.image_role: Read the left plot as a rectangular reversing torque of +20 Nm applied for 0.5 s. Read the right plot as the speed changing linearly during that same transient from -1500 rpm to +500 rpm.
planner_metadata.text_role: Use the text to know this is a no-load reversing transient and that the requested unknown is the drive moment of inertia; the rated 1500 rpm, 40 Nm is contextual, while the actual transient torque comes from the figure.
planner_metadata.knowledge_role: Use rotational dynamics under no load: net torque T = J alpha, where alpha = Delta omega / Delta t. Convert rpm to rad/s using omega = 2*pi*n/60, so Delta omega = (500 - (-1500))*2*pi/60. Then J = 20 / (Delta omega/0.5) ≈ 0.048 kg·m^2.

method.CoT_raw:
图像描述：图中左侧是转矩-时间曲线，显示一个矩形反向转矩脉冲，幅值标为 +20 Nm，持续时间标为 0.5 sec。右侧是速度-时间曲线，速度在瞬态前标为 -1500 rpm，瞬态后稳定在 +500 rpm。

推理：无负载条件下，转矩脉冲的冲量只用于改变转子的角动量，因此有 ∫T dt = J Δω。转矩-时间面积为 20 × 0.5 = 10 N·m·s。速度变化量为 500 - (-1500) = 2000 rpm。换算为角速度变化：Δω = 2000 × 2π / 60 = 209.44 rad/s。因此 J = 10 / 209.44 = 0.0477 kg·m^2，约为 0.048 kg·m^2。
